title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
snippet: A consumer buys goods or hires services for consideration; deficiency means fault, imperfection, shortcoming, or inadequacy in quality, nature, or manner of performance.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
snippet: Unfair trade practice includes false representation, misleading advertisement, bargain sale bait, and offering prizes without intention—consumers may seek remedies and penalties may apply.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
snippet: District Commission, State Commission, and National Commission have pecuniary jurisdiction based on compensation claimed; complaints can be filed where opposite party resides or cause of action arises.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
snippet: Commissions may refer disputes to mediation; settlement agreements have the status of Commission orders, encouraging faster resolution.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
snippet: Product liability action lies for harm caused by defective product against manufacturer, seller, or service provider subject to exceptions for misuse or altered product.

title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
snippet: Marketplaces must display seller details, grievance officer contacts, and refund timelines; misrepresentation or failure to honour cancellation rights can be actionable.

title: Legal Metrology Act, 2009
snippet: Pre-packed goods must declare net quantity, MRP, and manufacturer details; violations attract penalties and help consumers challenge short delivery or wrong labelling.

title: Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
snippet: Certain goods require conformity to Indian Standards; sale of non-conforming or sub-standard goods can lead to recall, compensation claims, and prosecution.

title: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
snippet: Dishonour of cheque for insufficiency of funds may lead to criminal complaint if statutory notice and conditions are complied with; civil recovery can also be pursued.

title: Information Technology Act, 2000
snippet: Identity theft, cheating by personation using computer resources, and unauthorised access or damage to data attract penalties; cyber fraud complaints can be filed with police and cyber cells.

title: Prize Chits and Money Circulation Schemes (Banning) Act, 1978
snippet: Promoting or participating in banned money circulation schemes is an offence; victims of pyramid or chit fraud may report to police and consumer forums where applicable.

title: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
snippet: Unsafe or misbranded food is regulated by FSSAI and State authorities; consumers can complain to the Food Safety Officer and seek damages in appropriate forums.

title: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (protection of policyholders)
snippet: Insurance disputes follow insurer grievance cell, Ombudsman, and consumer forums depending on facts; mis-selling and claim rejection can be challenged with documentation.

title: Anonymized e-commerce refund · Pune district
section: Illustrative outcome: refund directed in commission
snippet: Anonymized pattern from Pune district: a buyer filed in the District Consumer Commission with order invoice, delivery proof of defective phone, return pickup failure screenshots, and gateway dispute ID; after written arguments the forum directed refund with costs. Another buyer who missed the limitation period struggled. Training example only.
documents_used: Product photos and unboxing video link

title: Anonymized online purchase · Pune district
section: Illustrative outcome: complaint dismissed on limitation
snippet: Anonymized notes from Pune district: a user discovered a hidden defect after more than two years, had no extended warranty proof, and the commission held the complaint time-barred. Shorter delays and clear warranty terms help. Not a real citation.

title: Anonymized cyber-fraud complaint · Hyderabad district
section: Illustrative outcome: FIR and bank lien partial recovery
snippet: Anonymized pattern in Hyderabad: a victim filed cybercrime portal complaint with transaction hashes and bank passbook, police registered FIR and contacted the nodal bank; part of the transfer was frozen in time. Delays in reporting often mean money is gone. Illustrative story.
forum_visited: Police station / cyber cell with bank nodal coordination
